messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — launching the cloud marketplace listing next week. Need a final, minimal checklist: AWS/GCP/Azure creds + service account IDs, KMS key material + rotation policy, networking (VPC peering / NAT / allowed egress), SKU/billing metadata, trial entitlements, and listing assets (logo, description, docs). Who owns which piece?

alex.legal: I can own EULA & publisher agreement. Note: for EU customers we need a signed DPA before offering trials/capacity. Also need marketing sign-off on logos/brand. :white_check_mark:

sam.pm: I'll own SKU mapping and trial flow. Proposed trial: 14-day trial with usage cap; need the exact meter names for each cloud to wire billing. @kevin.ops can you provision a billing contact?

jia.eng: For images/artifacts we need AMI IDs, GCS manifest, and container registry path. Networking: marketplace packaging wants a public endpoint for the installer; customers will likely use customer-managed VPC peering afterwards. Clarify NAT egress rules for telemetry.

kevin.ops: I'll provision staging tenants and hook up Vault secrets. Please send AWS account IDs / GCP project numbers / Azure subscription IDs and required KMS ARNs. I'll push a terraform module into staging today.

marketplace-bot: Provision request received: workspace "staging-redwood-marketplace" created — creds pending verification. Logs: /internal/marketplace/provision/1778642000

maria.partnerships: alex — quick question: does the DPA need to be attached before marketplace listing is live or can it be required post-listing when onboarding EU customers? Also what's marketing's turnaround if we add a new hero image?

alex.legal: DPA ideally attached before enabling trials to EU customers. For listing itself, we can list with standard terms but gate trials by region until DPA complete. Marketing turnaround: ~48 hours if assets are final, longer if we need new photography or legal review on taglines.

sam.pm: Meter names for billing proposal: AWS -> "redwood_inference_usage", GCP -> "redwood_inference_units", Azure -> "redwood-inference-consumption". I'm opening a PR with these names to the billing manifest now.

jia.eng: Terraform snippet for registry + image permissions (posting so ops can reuse):

```
module "marketplace_registry" {
  source  = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/terraform//modules/marketplace-registry"
  cloud   = "aws"
  account = "123456789012"
}
```

jia.eng: For GCP we'll use Workload Identity to avoid long-lived keys; will create a service account and bind roles.

kevin.ops: Got it. After PR lands I'll run `terraform apply -target=module.marketplace_registry` in staging. Also note billing contact: ops-billing@redwood.ai. I'm adding runbook entries for rollback and telemetry hooks.

maria.partnerships: Outstanding blockers I see: 1) final marketing logos & alt-text, 2) KMS key policy + rotation, 3) confirmation of billing contact (thanks @kevin.ops). Can we assign owners to those three?

sam.pm: I'll own billing contact + SKU mapping.

alex.legal: I'll draft KMS rotation policy language and the license callout we need in the listing (we should declare Apache-2.0 plus a custom terms callout).

marketplace-bot: Credential scan complete: 2 missing items detected — GCP service account key not provisioned; Azure client secret not present. See /internal/marketplace/creds/scan-1778642000.

maria.partnerships: Thanks — @jia.eng please create the GCP service account using Workload Identity and tag PR. @kevin.ops please provision the Azure client secret into Vault after confirmation. Once both are in Vault we can re-run the scan and request final QA.

jia.eng: On it. I'll submit a PR that uses Workload Identity (no keys in repo). Will add instructions for reviewers to verify IAM bindings.

kevin.ops: I'll add the Azure secret into Vault and create short-lived credentials for staging tests.

sam.pm: Plan: cut the listing PR today, request legal + marketing review in the PR description, aim to publish to staging by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

kevin.ops: Confirmed — I'll run the staging publish and monitor telemetry. I'll also attach the rollback playbook to the PR.

maria.partnerships: Awesome. I'll follow up with a one-pager ops checklist and post the final PR link here when ready. Thanks team! :pray:
